Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
The action to burn the treatment does not specify whether it
is a directed action or an undirected one. Since players
are not supposed to figure this out based on who the action
is directed at:

Is the action directed or undirected? (It looks directed to me,
but it doesn't have the (D) symbol, so I can't be sure :->
--
